task_contract.title: Add a validated backend endpoint
task_contract.goal: Deliver the endpoint with independent verification and review
task_contract.desired_state: The endpoint is implemented and independently accepted
non_goals: Do not expand privileges or edit outside declared ownership
acceptance_criteria: All required checks and independent gates pass
constraints: Task Contract is immutable
Fail closed on incomplete evidence
Artifact and quality evidence must use exact grants from a committed generation
Failures must use canonical quality reports and persisted checks
Persist the canonical start request and role assignment digests

Persist only a sanitized input problem projection and bind its digest with the canonical start authority to the immutable run identity, use one schema-valid value-independent safe rejected Task Contract for every schema-invalid Task Contract while retaining canonical problem codes, preserve valid contracts rejected only by envelope or capability problems, and retain neither raw invalid values nor a redacted input's original idempotency key
Validate the parent generation chain and derive artifacts and metrics from Run State
Allow exactly one final-state reserved transition at the end of a generation-new trace suffix and bind only transition-specific generation-new evidence
Commit final-review failure evidence and its direct retry or stop transition in one request, one generation, and one save
Authorize blocked, failed, and human-approval reserved targets only from their target-specific same-generation cause projection
Require each reserved target kind's exact causal subset and reject unrelated same-generation evidence mixed with a valid cause
Derive each reserved target kind from its typed exact reason, report phase, kind, status, cause, failure, Finding conflict identity and positions, or canonical input problems
Resolve failure history per issue without hiding unresolved sibling failures
Append a new Finding digest when a resolved identity recurs and reopen the catalog until that new Finding is resolved
Validate each receipt path against its prior write-enabled generation, exact historical grant, Task Contract scope, ownership, provenance, and current Registry scope
Bind source introduction to its exact committed generation, closed target identity, artifact, and provenance, then require exact carry until disappearance
Keep the approved initial reports, implementation approval, Task Contract, and artifact source basis immutable across the accepted source chain

After an artifact-changing verified fix, reset current source, completion, approval, and all reports to canonical inactive evidence for the new artifact revision while preserving historical staging and requiring fresh source introduction

Use one pure canonical inactive source projection and require its exact run, contract, artifact, status, null source bindings, no-overwrite, and shadow connection fields in every inactive historical generation
Bind completion to the verified source, Task Contract, artifact, all four report digests, and completed generation
Accept cancellation only through the orchestrator-owned dedicated cancel event and keep interrupt mapped to blocked
Detect one-sided root or anchor rewind and local integrity mismatches
Treat a coherent coordinated root-and-anchor rewind by an equally privileged actor as out of scope
Validate Run State schema before semantic replay
retry_conditions: changed input, diff, or environment evidence
